title: fix(rest): /meta negotiates the request locale against the held locales before it picks a pack
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_

Fixes #36466
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用以英文编写、默认面向中文用户、并持有英文语言包时，浏览器语言为美式英语等地区写法的用户，在对象元数据接口里看到的对象名称由中文变为英文原文，和同一请求下保存报错里的名称一致；没有对应语言包的语言仍按默认语言显示。
- 为什么做:多语言标签统一的后续：让元数据接口和服务端各处读者用同一种方式把地区语言写法对到已有语言包。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某个地区语言写法的用户看到的对象名称语言不对，不影响数据和权限，合并后可直接回退。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The card's ruling, quoted: "Make the `/meta` read (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) negotiate the request tag the way the other readers do before it picks a pack. No spec change."

- `metaTranslateOptions` (the `ResolveOptions` every metadata-document translation builds) now carries `locale` as the request tag negotiated against the locales the i18n service reports: `resolveBundleLocale` (`@objectstack/spec/system`, the platform's one locale ladder) over `getLocales()`. That is the question objectql's `negotiatedMessageLocale` and plugin-approvals' `negotiatedReaderLocale` already ask, over the same set. Neither of those is importable from `@objectstack/rest` without a new export (objectql does not export it; plugin-approvals is downstream), so a private helper beside it (`negotiatedTranslationLocale`) repeats only the offered-set plumbing and calls the shared rule. It adds no second rule and no new export.
- The tag passes through untouched when there is nothing to negotiate against: no service, no `getLocales`, a throwing, empty or non-array answer, or no match. So a locale the deployment holds no pack for still walks the declared chain to the default locale.
- Reach: `metaTranslateOptions` is the one builder, so the item read and the list read on both transports (`RestServer` and the runtime dispatcher, which share `translateMetaDocument` / `translateMetaList`), the view container, the stale-plural rule, the `GET /meta` types listing and the public form's object labels (`translateOptionsFor` delegates here) all read the negotiated tag. The doc locale collapse (`resolveDocLocale`) and `extractLocale`'s other callers (export, import template) are untouched.
- No `packages/spec` change.

## Tests

New top-level describe `#36466 §7` in `packages/rest/src/meta-i18n-declared-fallback-chain.test.ts`, the shared harness of the `/meta` i18n pins (§6 is this deployment's `sourceLocale` case). The fixture is `sourceLocale: 'en'`, `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, the chain collapsed to `zh-CN`, a `zh-CN` pack, and an `en` pack that holds no `account` rows.

- Card pin 1: an `en-US` request with only an `en` pack reads `Account` from `/meta` (item read, list read, and bare `en` agree).
- Card pin 2: a request for a locale with no pack at all (`fr-FR`), and a header-less request, still read the default locale (`客户`).
- Control: with no `en` locale held, `en-US` has nothing to negotiate to and walks to `客户`; `zh` still reads the `zh-CN` pack.
- Acceptance parity: for `en-US` and `fr-FR`, `/meta`'s label and the label objectql's `DELETE_RESTRICTED` (code and status asserted) names on the same i18n service are the same (`Account` and `客户`), and the other one is absent.
- Cached arm (`getMetaItemCached`, the default door): `en-US` is served `Account` and `en` the same body; the `en-US` validator revalidates its own request (`304`); sent with `zh-CN` or `fr-FR` it answers `200` with `客户`, never a `304` for the English body.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cache key (measured, unchanged here).** The cached arm's validator is the protocol's hash of the untranslated document folded with the tag the request SENT (`extractLocale`, `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, #1319). Translation runs after it with the negotiated tag. So within a running server each sent tag maps to one body: `en-US` and `en` get separate validators over identical bodies (fewer shared `304`s, never a wrong one), and a validator never crosses languages (pinned above). Keying the validator on the negotiated tag would need `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, outside this card's file surface, so it is raised as a question in the report. Not pinned, because it is already true of any pack edit: the validator hashes no translation input, so a client that cached an `en-US` body before this deploy can be answered `304` on the old `客户` body until the document changes.
- **plugin-security does not negotiate (measured; the card's premise holds for objectql and the #36464 readers only).** Reading taken with a scratch copy of `controlled-by-parent-master-edit-user-message.test.ts` (deleted, not committed) on an i18n service with `sourceLocale: 'en'`, `defaultLocale`/fallback `zh-CN` and an `en` pack: the master-detail refusal's `userMessage` names the master `Contract` for `en`, `合同` for `en-US`, and `Contract` for `fr-FR`. `denialLocaleOf` returns the raw request tag and `denialLabels` hands it to `translateObject` as written. So after this PR, `/meta` (`Contract`) and plugin-security (`合同`) still disagree for `en-US`, and for `fr-FR` (`/meta` serves `合同`, plugin-security falls back to an `en` sentence naming `Contract`). This is reported for the seat to file, not fixed here.
- The public form and the `GET /meta` types listing negotiate too, because they read the same builder. That is the same defect class on the same function; no pin was added for them.
